tasks.title: Implement TodoStoreRepository (load/save, atomic, path resolution)
acceptance_criteria: `todo/store.py` exists, exporting `default_store_path()`, `load(path)`, `save(path, items)`
`default_store_path()` returns `$TODO_STORE` verbatim when set; otherwise
`load(path)` on a non-existent path returns `[]`
`save(path, items)` then `load(path)` round-trips exactly (same items, same order)
`save()` uses `tempfile.mkstemp` (same directory as `path`) + `os.replace` — never a bare
Request shape matches [[contracts/todo-store.contract#Write-Input]] table
Response mapping matches [[contracts/todo-store.contract#Read-Output]] table
All error codes in [[contracts/todo-store.contract#Error-Cases]] are handled
`load()` returns `[]` (never `None`, never throws) when the store file does not exist
`save(path, [])` then `load(path)` returns `[]` — an emptied store is a valid, loadable state

tasks.title: Build bin/todo argparse dispatcher with top-level error boundary
acceptance_criteria: `bin/todo` exists and is executable (`chmod +x`), shebang `#!/usr/bin/env python3`
`python3 bin/todo add "x"` / `list` / `done 1` / `rm 1` all reach their respective
`python3 bin/todo` (no subcommand) exits non-zero with a usage message, no traceback
`python3 bin/todo bogus-command` exits non-zero with a usage message, no traceback
Any `StoreCorruptedError` raised by a command function is caught at the top level, printed

tasks.title: Implement todo add <text>
acceptance_criteria: `python3 bin/todo add "ship it"` against a fresh `$TODO_STORE` prints `added #1: ship it`
A second `add` against the same store prints `added #2: ...` (position is `len(items)`
The store file on disk after `add` contains the new item appended at the end, all prior
No stdout is written if `save()` raises — see [[usecases/UC-AddTodo#Steps]] step 3

tasks.title: Implement todo list
acceptance_criteria: `python3 bin/todo list` against a store with 2 items (`ship it` not done, `write the spec`
Output contains no ANSI escape codes (`\x1b[`) — plain text only
`python3 bin/todo list` against a fresh (non-existent) `$TODO_STORE` prints exactly
`python3 bin/todo list` against a store file containing `[]` prints exactly `(no items)`

tasks.title: Implement todo done <n>
acceptance_criteria: `todo done 1` against a 2-item store marks item 1 done, prints `done #1: <text>`, exits 0
The store file after `done 1` has item 1's `done` field `true`; item 2 unchanged
Marking an already-done item done again still succeeds (idempotent), prints the same
`todo done 0` (below min) against a 2-item store: exit 1, stderr
`todo done 1` (min, valid): exit 0, item 1 marked done
`todo done 2` (max, valid, 2-item store): exit 0, item 2 marked done
`todo done 3` (max+1, 2-item store): exit 1, stderr
`todo done abc` (non-integer): exit 1, stderr `error: invalid item number 'abc'`, store

tasks.title: Implement todo rm <n>
acceptance_criteria: `todo rm 1` against a 2-item store removes item 1, prints `removed #1: <text of old item 1>`, exits 0
The store file after `rm 1` has exactly 1 item — the former item 2, `text`/`done` unchanged
After a removal, a subsequent `list` renumbers remaining items starting at 1 (no gaps)
`todo rm 0` (below min) against a 2-item store: exit 1, stderr
`todo rm 1` (min, valid): exit 0, store now has 1 item
`todo rm 2` (max, valid, 2-item store): exit 0, store now has 1 item
`todo rm 3` (max+1, 2-item store): exit 1, stderr `error: no item 3 (list has 2 items)`,
`todo rm xyz` (non-integer): exit 1, stderr `error: invalid item number 'xyz'`, store unchanged
